about: Autopilot playthroughs (tools/play/seq.sh): the map each chamber must change to ('unset' where it ends on a chamber with no next map), and its game seconds. tools/play/check.sh fails when a chamber stops reaching its next map or its time moves by more than the tolerance (the larger of tolSeconds and tolFraction of the time). escape_02 has no next map: it ends when the second GLaDOS core burns, so its time is what catches a regression. Measured 2026-11-25 on gabriel/portal-transit.
